protocol: Five topics registered before generation; frozen code; no operator recovery, no scene-specific templates, one configured automatic repair. Record all outcomes and manual inspection separately. User trials are not performed.

topics.topic: How does rain form in a cloud?
How do plant roots take up water from soil?
Why does a black shirt feel warmer than a white shirt in sunlight?
How does a flashlight use a battery to make light?
Why does a puddle shrink on a warm day?

outcome: Superseded after identified defects; release target not met
